Has room for improvements
Sep 2016 • Friends
Visited the outlet at Hanoi Creative City after our bike tour. This cafe has a very modern industrial but cosy setting. Tried one of the specialty drinks (plum I think) but it was too sweet for my liking and had to keep adding water to my drink to dilute the sweetness.

Did not try the food. One of our friends wanted the banh mi but was told it was sold out.

Overall ambience was nice but as far as food and drinks go - may need some improvements.

A Lovely Cafe with a Great Atmosphere!
Mar 2015 • Solo
I was near Boo Cafe and had heard good things so I decided to check it out. I was impressed by the cozy atmosphere (both inside and outdoor seating) and found the staff to be very friendly and attentive. 

I was craving something healthy so had a salad that was delicious! One of their fruit-flavored iced teas was also very good and hit the spot on a hot day. Of course, I had to have a dessert! Everything looked wonderful and the ice cream that I chose was a great way to end the experience.

The location is perfect next to the Vincom shopping center. I look forward to going back and trying more of the menu items. 

The food was great and prices were very reasonable. The staff was friendly and attentive. All in all, it was an experience I would recommend.

Creative cafe and clothes store in Hanoi
Dec 2014 • Friends
Boo clothes store is on the base floor and Boo cafe is one the 2nd Floor. Boo Cafe has creative decorations, open space and closed space. They serve delicious drinks and cakes in creative ways. I felt cold when sat in outdoor space, then the staff brought me thin blanket but really warm. It made me feel so comfortable. I love cakes in Boo Cafe. It's best to gather with friends here. The cafe closes quite soon, at 11pm. I wish they can open it a little longer.
